Zombies are at your door… so you lock it.
But that lock is held by two tiny screws… that don't even reach the wall.
So you push the couch against it.
Friction does not care about your feelings.
So you swap those tiny screws for three-inch ones… on the lock, and on the hinges.
Now they bite into the stud… the bones of your house.
To break the door, they have to break the house.
Then wedge a bar under the handle.
The harder they push, the harder it digs into the floor.
Congratulations… you have properly barricaded a door.
